snippet.title: Icebounds Secrets: The Frostwood Bane Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Elephant Games proudly presents the thrilling tale of the mysterious, snow-covered town of Frostwood in the Icebound Secrets series!

Lost beneath a heavy blanket of snow, Frostwood is facing one of its harshest winters. Narrow streets have turned into an icy labyrinth, and ancient houses stand frozen in time. But the true terror begins at night - supernatural figures emerge from the darkness, resembling phantoms of old legends. Silent and relentless, they hunt the living…

Into this town, suspended between myth and reality, arrives a journalist-detective determined to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearances. What dark secrets lie hidden beneath Frostwood’s frozen surface? Can he solve the chilling mystery and save the townspeople while risking his own life?

Immerse yourself in a world of mystery and danger in this new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game!

Available for Game Club Members on March 25th!

https://www.bigfishgames.com/
